prespecification_amendment: After primary_v1 stopped before candidate construction, bind the documented read-only public-data cache. After primary_v2 stopped before a method-cell result, preserve the recorded pymoo 0.6.2 comparator rows for the all-method matched-cardinality analysis and restrict new front-level reruns to shared custom-engine and deterministic methods; no observed result informed either amendment. After primary_v3, classify clipping incidence with a 1e-12 numerical tolerance because the only analytic-bound excursions were negative roundoff no larger than 3.36e-17; hypervolume values and scientific factors are unchanged.
analysis_unit: one seeded method-scenario run for stochastic methods; one unique method-scenario output for deterministic rules
candidate_pool: the existing public 120-candidate P5 pool, filtered only by the seven registered scenario definitions

matched_output.rule: consume the one compromise already selected in each preserved run by the shared minimum normalized-objective-sum rule
matched_output.primary_readout: compromise cost index, reliability, renewable support, risk, and portfolio size; full-front hypervolume is retained only as context
matched_output.source: preserved pymoo 0.6.2 main-run rows; deterministic rows deduplicated to one unique method-scenario output
matched_output.inference: descriptive; deterministic outputs are not replicated

hypervolume_schemes.bounds: the shared fixed seeded bounds with 5% padding
the shared fixed seeded bounds with 5% padding
shared bounds expanded by 25% of their padded span on both sides

sensitivity.design: one factor at a time around the registered formulation
sensitivity.seed_schedule: 700000 + 7919 * seed_index, common across cells and methods
sensitivity.primary_metric: full feasible-front hypervolume under analytic bounds and reference point 1.2
sensitivity.secondary_metric: matched single-point hypervolume under the same bounds and reference point for the new custom-engine subset

external_public_record_backtests: not rerun; existing NERC and MTEP checks remain descriptive because no portfolio-level randomization family is introduced
runtime_limitation: new pymoo 0.6.2 front reruns are unavailable because cached moocore/CFFI wheels do not share one host ABI; no different pymoo version is substituted
shared_code_policy: no shared P5/P6 source edit is authorized or required; regress the shared test suite after the stage-local run
